verdict.rationale: Pilot's pricing page claims "Instant AI answers about past transactions and current cash flow, plus run scenarios," which is the product's own natural-language query capability. It is a single thin marketing line with no documentation of how it works or what actions it can take. Asking questions of the human team through the portal or Slack is human service, not natural-language operation of the product, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: documentation of the natural-language interface, evidence it can perform actions or operations beyond answering questions, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Instant AI answers about past transactions and current cash flow, plus run scenarios to plan ahead
